what_the_source_says: Frazer et al. 2016 Cochrane: smoke-free laws clearly reduce secondhand-smoke exposure and cardiovascular admissions, but evidence of an effect on smoking prevalence and consumption is INCONSISTENT; several studies found no change beyond existing trends
caveat: The lognormal prior can only give a benefit, so S2 is optimistic

what_the_source_says: Cochrane 2023 network meta-analysis (CD015226): nicotine e-cigarettes, varenicline and cytisine give about 7-8 additional quitters per 100 at >=6 months (95% CrI 4-13); combination NRT OR 1.93 (1.61-2.34). Cahill 2013: varenicline OR 2.88 vs placebo
caveat: Trial efficacy. The effect in Armenian practice is probably lower
